about: Joliette is a city in Lanaudière, Quebec, on the L’Assomption River northeast of Montreal. It serves as a regional cultural and service centre, with a historic downtown, arts institutions, and festival tradition. Highways 31 and 158 link it toward Montreal’s north shore. About 21,000 people live in Joliette.
